title: Report outline
description: Maps report sections to sub-questions and to the claim ids each section may cite. Carries claim ids ONLY: citation numbers are assigned solely by merge-threads.sh in citation-map.json, and the assembler resolves ids to numbers at assembly time. Two numbering authorities would drift.

section_id.description: Path component for report/sections/<section_id>.md. No slashes, never . or ..

sub_question.description: The plan.md sub-question this section answers.

claim_ids.description: The ONLY claims this section may cite. The assembler diffs cited against assigned and fails on anything outside this set.

word_budget.description: Target length. Capped at 3000 so no single generation call is asked for the whole report — the ceiling this change exists to remove.
